attributes.name: Mountain Pattern Armor
attributes.powers:
If proficient with heavy armors, reveal this card to add 1d4 to your Constitution or Diplomacy non-combat check.

Recharge this card to reduce Combat damage dealt to you by 5. 

Banish this card to reduce all damage dealt to you to 0; if proficient with heavy armors, bury it instead. 

If proficient with heavy armors, you may recharge this card when you reset your hand.
